claim_boundary: Static schema and already-validated value joins only; no runtime persistence, native owner dispatch, GUI execution, or governance reseal.

implementation.schema: Only onboarding_action_request/result change: Ready admitted for Back and three exact result destinations bound to path/disposition. Earlier Back stages unchanged, including provider_setup still excluded.
implementation.join: Applied Ready Back requires a prevalidated ready_back_session with active status and exact common session/continuation fields. It pops exactly the prior history entry; every other continuation field is preserved except the existing incremented revision. Request focus remains exact. No new owner route, operation or production receipt is permitted.
implementation.admission: Missing, mismatched, interrupted, deferred, skipped, completed or cancelled session cannot authorize applied Back. resume_session is not a substitute. Existing nonwriting disabled/rejected outcomes require no active Ready witness.
implementation.caller_obligation: All supplied values, including ready_back_session, must first pass schema and individual semantic validation and native reference authentication. This helper never supplies that authority.

verification.base_counterfactual: All three final positive continuations and active sessions validate against base; all three requests and all three results fail base Ready exclusions. Old join returns no findings without an active session witness. New schema and join admit the exact positives.
verification.preexisting_failure: test_existing_family_and_retention_census_is_unchanged hard-codes 90 families; base and current registry contain 294. Both test file and registry are byte-identical to base. The other 53 phase tests pass; no census or governance artifact was changed.
verification.causal_checks: Schema-plus-semantic-valid substitutions test Client/focus/SCM/forge, deferred/connect plan refs, request/result correlation, witness identity/revision/generation/state, all nonactive statuses, focus redirects and owner dispatch. Complete preservation is additionally guarded field-by-field with explicit defensive invalid-value tests, not misreported as causal-valid negatives.
verification.refusal_checks: Disabled and rejected outcomes for all three paths are valid, same-stage and nonwriting; attempted session write is structurally rejected.

preserved_composition_boundaries.null_draft_projection: The existing connect Ready projection schema admits null draft references that cannot match a valid queued durable session. PWIZ-021 requires retained draft identity distinct from Project identity. The exact join rejects this incomplete projection without normalizing it; the standalone schema looseness is not repaired or claimed closed here.
preserved_composition_boundaries.active_branch: Current owner phases do not admit any non-null active branch at Ready. Valid positives preserve null; injection is an existing semantic rejection as well as an equality rejection, not a causal-valid negative. No artificial Ready owner branch was introduced.
